item.title: Flint: Majority Investment Raised From Cinven To Advance International Growth
item.description: Cinven announced that it has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Flint Global, marking the second investment from its new European mid-market strategy. The deal will be completed by the end of the year. Financial terms were not disclosed. item.title: Wrexham AFC Welcomes New Minority Investment From Apollo Sports Capital
item.description: Wrexham AFC has received a new minority investment from Apollo Sports Capital, an affiliate of Apollo Global Management, marking a significant step in the club’s long-term growth plan and its ambitions to eventually reach the Premier League. Majority owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds will continue to oversee all club operations as controlling shareholders.
